rows.label: Rising Tide
rows.note: needs The War Within; builds your own Railjack

rows.label: Mastery Rank 14
rows.note: enforced at the Ergo Glast purchase, unlike a Sister-dropped Tenet weapon

conditions: You can join someone else's Railjack without owning one, but public squads are mostly un-upgraded ships, AFK turret-sitters and trolls — solo or a recruit-chat squad is the norm.
Sisters of Parvos do not carry the Tenet Grigori; every Tenet melee (Grigori, Livia, Exec, Agendus) plus Tenet Ferrox is Ergo Glast-only.

rows.label: Corrupted Holokey
rows.note: guaranteed 1 per run plus a ~35.7% roll for 5 more; about 14-15 Saturn runs for 40
rows.alt: ~7 runs in the Veil at 2 guaranteed + 37.5% for 10

conditions: Boosters do nothing — Resource Booster, Resource Drop Chance Booster, Drop Chance Blessing and Retriever mods are all explicitly excluded from Holokey drops.
Corpus Railjack missions bolt a slow on-foot objective onto the space fight; stay on Grineer Proxima nodes, which you can run to the objective and back out of.
Drops are end-of-mission only. Running a Void Storm Survival long does not multiply your keys.
You do not need to bring or open a relic for the Holokey reward table, though it's free value to bring one anyway.
bonuses: Finishing a Sister of Parvos Final Confrontation pays 1 Holokey per squad member per Sister, up to 4 — a side income if you're already hunting Sisters, too slow to farm on its own.

disclosures.title: solo Railjack crew setup
disclosures.body: Hire an engineer first (defender role, high Repair stat, a beam weapon like Phantasma) so hull breaches and fires handle themselves. Two gunners with a hitscan turret (Talyn best, Pulsar second) clear fighters. Switch the engineer to pilot while you're on foot and a large-projectile forward gun (Vort, Laith, Cryophon) helps the AI hit radiators. Forward Artillery one-shots crewships through an intact engine at effectively unlimited range; use Shatter Burst on shielded ones first. Lavos or Hildryn put Railjack abilities on cooldowns instead of energy costs.

conditions: One copy per rotation; the bonus element and percentage reroll every 4 days at 00:00 UTC — you cannot buy two in the same window to fuse immediately.
bonuses: Buy the first copy above roughly 36% rather than waiting for a perfect roll; Elemental Vice frees the element later, so only the percentage matters.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy you've invested in — the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter and Elemental Vice are all destroyed.
Only one copy per rotation, so each fusion step costs another 40 keys and a wait, unlike a Sister-dropped Tenet weapon where you just farm more kills.
Elemental Vice needs rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, 20 platinum from the Market, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.

disclosures.title: the currency math
disclosures.body: 40 keys is roughly 14-15 Saturn runs, so a single Grigori is doable in a sitting. The number people quote in despair is the full set: 200 keys for one of each of Glast's five weapons, and up to 2,000 for all five at 60%.
